stem:
Read this quotation from paragraph 5.

“Anyone who has an idea worth sharing is capable of giving a powerful talk,” Anderson writes in his book. . . .

What is the most likely reason the author includes the quotation?

options.label: F
options.text: To demonstrate that other writers share her views

options.label: G
options.text: To give readers confidence in their own potential

options.label: H
options.text: To present an opinion that differs from her own

options.label: J
options.text: To suggest that writing a good speech requires talent
